role: Subprocess plugin for the meta CLI implementing `meta project list/ls/check/dependents`: renders the .meta project tree (recursive, JSON, linked-worktree context), verifies projects are cloned and consistent, and computes reverse dependents. Inspection-only despite the manifest's "sync and update" wording — cloning is delegated to `meta git update`.
northstar: Meta makes multi-repo feel like monorepo without the downsides; the canon machinery stays green, versioned by the parent distribution.
